summary: Form 8-K filed by Brand Engagement Network Inc. (BNAI) to report completion of its acquisition of Cataneo GmbH, a German LLC. The aggregate purchase price was $19.5 million, comprising $9 million in cash and 250,792 shares of BNAI common stock valued at $37.88/share. The cash portion included a $1 million deposit paid at signing; the remainder was funded via a private placement of common stock and warrants at $39.59 per share. Cataneo reported EUR 8.6 million in FY2025 revenue. The deal closed on June 30, 2026. No advisors or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing also notes the unregistered sale of equity securities for funding. Watch for integration execution and potential earnout or earnout adjustments.
